5chan_description: 5chan is a fully decentralized and open-source imageboard, where anyone can create and cryptographically own unlimited boards. Board owners host and moderate their board, and set its <1>Rules</1>. All data is text-only and it's shared peer-to-peer, including links to embed images. Check out the <2>FAQs</2> to learn more. Feel free to click on a board below that interests you and jump right in!

pass_intro_body: 5chan Pass is a planned paid supporter pass for 5chan. It is not available yet. When it launches, 5chan Pass holders will be able to participate in directory voting, post on /vip/, and bypass typing a CAPTCHA verification or similar posting challenge on 5chan boards that support the 5chan Pass challenge. Directory governance mechanics are still being finalized and are expected to include BSO-holder alignment instead of pass-only final control. Checkout will be crypto only. There is no live purchase, activation, or renewal flow today.
pass_question_need: Will I need it to browse or post?
pass_question_bypass: Will it bypass bans or board rules?
pass_question_vpn: Will VPNs, proxies, or IP changes matter?
pass_question_privileges: Will it grant moderation powers or board ownership?
pass_answer_available: No. This page is a placeholder so the future 5chan Pass route already exists, but there is nothing to buy, activate, or renew yet.
pass_answer_what_does: When it launches, 5chan Pass will let eligible users participate in directory voting, post on <vip>/vip/</vip>, and bypass typing a CAPTCHA verification or similar posting challenge on all 5chan boards that support the pass challenge. Directory voting is planned as a governance signal, not a pass-only final override. Reporting is not available yet, so the pass does not currently apply to reports.
pass_answer_what_is: 5chan Pass is an upcoming supporter purchase for people who want to fund 5chan directly. When it launches, it will be used for participating in directory voting, zero-friction posting on boards that support the 5chan Pass challenge, and posting on <vip>/vip/</vip>.
pass_answer_payment: 5chan Pass will be sold through a crypto-only checkout when it becomes available. No credit cards, PayPal, or other fiat payment methods will be accepted.
pass_answer_challenge: On boards that support the 5chan Pass challenge, pass holders will be able to bypass typing a CAPTCHA verification or similar challenge before posting. This is similar in spirit to how 4chan Pass reduces posting friction, except 5chan reports are not available yet.
pass_answer_vip: Only 5chan Pass users will be able to post on <vip>/vip/</vip>. Browsing rules and long-term direction for that board can still evolve, but the current plan is that posting there is restricted to pass holders.
pass_answer_what_not: 5chan Pass will not give moderation powers, board ownership, final directory governance control, or any way to ignore board-specific <rules>rules</rules>. It also will not unlock anything today, because the feature has not launched yet.
pass_answer_pricing: Yes, the planned pricing model is the same simple structure: Passes cost $30 for 1 year or $60 for 3 years, which is about $1.67 per month or less than a single 20oz bottle of soda.
pass_answer_proceeds: Net proceeds from 5chan Pass are intended to support the continued development and operation of 5chan, including compensating core contributors and covering infrastructure and other project costs. Any future allocation to buying or burning BSO will be disclosed separately before it takes effect. Purchases will create public on-chain transactions, so buyers should assume their purchase wallet activity can be publicly visible.
pass_answer_nft: 5chan Pass will be an NFT under the hood, powered by the open-source <mintPass>MintPass</mintPass> service. The 5chan Pass challenge will only accept NFTs minted within the last year, so an NFT older than one year will count as expired until it is renewed or replaced.
pass_answer_need: No. 5chan Pass is not required to read boards, subscribe to boards, or post normally. It is for specific benefits like participating in directory voting, posting on <vip>/vip/</vip>, and zero-friction posting on boards that support the challenge.
pass_answer_vpn: No. Because 5chan Pass is planned as an NFT-based credential, it is not meant to depend on a fixed IP address. There is no intended restriction based on VPN use, proxies, or changing networks.
pass_answer_fiat: No. When 5chan Pass launches, payment will be crypto only.
pass_answer_bypass: No. A pass is not a way around bans, posting restrictions, or board moderation. Every board still sets and enforces its own rules.
pass_answer_privileges: No. Buying a pass will not make someone a moderator, an admin, or the owner of a board. It is a supporter purchase and participation credential, not a way to override board or ecosystem governance.
